_description: Alias dictionary for the DHG502 Yan-Qin SNA corpus. Keys are canonical node_ids; values list the regex surface-form patterns (as they appear in the corpus) that resolve to that node. Context-dependent terms are NOT merged silently - see flagged_ambiguous_terms.
_note_on_regex: Aliases are stored as Python regex fragments because many surface forms are short (e.g. 丹, 嘉, 光) and only disambiguated by lookaround context. Use re.search on segment text.

Jing_Ke: 軻(?=曰|既|遂|知|嘗|者|奉|和|逐|被|自知|廢|怒)
Qin_Shi_Huang: (?<![燕齊魏楚趙代先文武景湣幽繆悼孝威宣昭莊襄])王(?=曰|大喜|聞之|問|如邯鄲|使人|初并|義而許|負劍|以為然|收而與|何以去|必厚割|遂降|下其議)
Wang_Jian: (?<=王)翦(?=將|曰|果|謝|遂|既|行|至|日|因|使人|言)
Yan: 燕(?!王喜|太子丹|丹|王及|王亡|王使|王聞|王竊|王誠|王拜|王乃|王怒|王不聽|王大怒|王命|王召|王以|王必|王蹵|王將|王卒|王人|王喜)
Qin: 秦(?!王政|始皇|始皇帝|皇帝|昭王|莊襄王|王翦|王賁|舞陽|武陽|將|兵|軍|法|地|人|國|王寵臣|王必|王聞|王大喜|王謂|王發|王驚|王環|王復|王方|王還|王遂|王負劍)
Zhao: 趙(?!王遷|孝成王|悼襄王|幽繆王|公子嘉|王酒|王甚愛|將|使|人|氏|民|軍|兵|地|國|廥|與燕|聽|不能支|不能支秦)
Qi: 齊(?!王建|王將|王遂|王不聽|王還|王取筆|王曰|威、宣|威可立|人|地|亦東|軍|兵|師|之鋭)

flagged_ambiguous_terms.reason: 「臣光曰」 opens Sima Guang's historiographical comments in the ZZTJ segments (S045, S052). The 光 here is the historian Sima Guang, NOT 田光; the lookaround in Tian_Guang's alias excludes it. If you want Sima Guang as an authorial node, add it explicitly.

Bare 「王」 is context-dependent: in ZZTJ/Shiji annalistic passages it usually = 秦王政 (S028, S035, S037, S039, S041, S052), in 燕策三/燕召公世家 = 燕王喜 (S017, S021, S085), in 趙世家 = the reigning Zhao king (S085, S090), in 齊 passages = 齊王建 (S049, S050, S051). Mapped per-segment by context; verify each occurrence.
Bare 「太子」 almost always = 燕太子丹, but S084 「太子死」 refers to the Zhao crown prince (趙孝成王太子) in the 趙世家 annals; verify before merging.

「使者」 is a role, not a named individual: the Yan envoy to Qin (S065-S066, also the Jing Ke embassy S010-S011/S080), the Yan envoy to Zhao (S018), and Yan envoys in S021/S036. Referent changes across passages; kept unmerged.
Bare 「趙王」: S021/S085 「爲趙王酒」 = 趙孝成王; S006/S023/S058/S076 「虜趙王」 = 趙王遷; S065/S090 = reigning Zhao king in the envoy/春平君 episodes (孝成王 or 悼襄王, text does not specify). Verify S065 and S090.
Editorial collation: text reads 蒙武, emendation suggests 蒙恬 (S037, S040). Mapped to Meng_Wu (text as written); verify whether the underlying event refers to 蒙恬.
S053 「齊威、宣之時」 read as 齊威王、齊宣王 (allusion); but S050 「齊威可立」 uses 齊威 as an abstract noun ('Qi's prestige'), not the king. Verify S053 reading.
S018 「商容、箕左之累」: the received ZGC text has 箕子 (Jizi); this copy writes 箕左. Kept verbatim as its own allusion node; verify against your edition.
「狗屠」 is an unnamed occupation (the dog-butcher of the Yan market, companion of 荊軻 and 髙漸離). Treated as a generic person node; drop it if you only want named individuals.
S085 「以尉文封相國廉頗爲信平君」: 尉文 is usually read as a place name (the fief), not a person. Excluded from the node table; verify if you want it as a locality node.
S029 「太后薨」 (ZZTJ 始皇帝十九年) and S058 「始皇帝母太后崩」 refer to the Qin king's mother, unnamed in the text. Excluded as an unnamed person; verify if you want a node.
「先王」 = deceased predecessor king; referent varies (Yan's 先王 in S010/S018/S019, Zhou's 先王 in S052, Wei's 先王 in S039). Left unmerged.
The Xiongnu chanyu is invoked only as the object of the proposed alliance (S002, S073); no personal name is given. Represented by the state node Xiongnu; verify if you want a separate person node.
